subject: Partner GTM commission & lead-registration playbook (Pulse Analytics)
messages:

Date: 2026-05-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring reseller + referral model with Redwood

Hi Karthik,

Really enjoyed the product tour last week — congrats on the latency improvements you showcased. Pulse is seeing customer demand for tighter embedding costs and a predictable SLAs path; we think Redwood could be a strategic runtime option for our customers.

High-level ask: we want to outline a simple partner model that covers 1) referral fees for introductions, 2) reseller options for co-selling on a single invoice, and 3) basic lead registration guardrails so both sides get credit for sourced opportunities.

Can we get a short playbook (terms + ops) from you that covers commission rates, payment cadence, lead-protection windows, and any compliance asks we should prepare for (SOC2 evidence, region restrictions)? We have a legal contact who will also want to see sample contract language.

Would love to hop on a 30-min call this week to align. Available Thu/Fri mornings PT.

Thanks,
Aanya
Partnerships, Pulse Analytics

Subject: Re: Exploring reseller + referral model with Redwood

Hi Aanya,

Thanks — really excited about the potential. Thu/Fri AM PT works; I booked 30m for Friday 10:00 PT. Invite attached.

For the playbook we typically separate three pathways:
- Referral (introduction only): one-time commission tied to first invoice (percentage of first 12 months).
- Reseller (Pulse invoices customer): tiered margin or reseller discount; Redwood settles commission to Pulse on collected revenue.
- Co-sell / joint opportunity: deal registration with a short exclusive window for credit assignment.

I’ll follow up after the call with a concise proposal and a sample term sheet for your legal. Looping Ben and Marissa so ops/sales can weigh in.

See you Friday — calendar invite in a separate email.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aanya Rao <aanya@pulseanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood <> Pulse: draft commercial playbook (attached)

Aanya — thanks for the conversation this morning. Attached is a one-page draft proposal that captures what we discussed and gives concrete numbers to test internally at Pulse. Key points below (summary from the attached PDF):

1) Referral (introductions)
- Eligible credit: 12 months of net Redwood revenue from the referred customer.
- Rate: 15% of net revenue for first 12 months.
- Payment: Within 45 days of Redwood invoice collection; net of refunds/chargebacks.

2) Reseller (Pulse invoices customer; Redwood delivers)
- Reseller discount: 20% off list (Pulse sets customer price).
- Commission: If Pulse elects revenue share instead of reseller margin, Redwood offers 10% recurring commission on net revenue for contract term (paid quarterly).
- Responsibility: Pulse manages billing, Redwood provides SLOS and direct support per agreed routing.

3) Deal registration / lead protection
- Registration window: 90 days from initial written intro.
- Qualification: MQL -> qualified demo -> proposal. A simple registration form + date-stamped email thread suffices.

4) Payment mechanics and reserves
- Redwood retains a 10% commission reserve for 45 days to cover refunds/credits on new customers (standard for first invoice cycle).
- Monthly reporting via shared Drive + HubSpot integration (we’ll send a CSV export each month).

5) Compliance & onboarding
- SOC2 cert available; region restrictions: EU data must be routed to EU region cluster (may affect cost).

Attachment: Redwood-Pulse-Commission-Proposal-20260521.pdf (single-page summary + sample payment clause).

Notes / open items for legal:
- Audit rights for commission reconciliation.
- Indemnity and limitation carve-outs for reseller billing.
- Termination: effect on commissions after termination (we propose commissions on revenue collected within 12 months post-termination for referred customers).

Can Marissa/Ben/Laura review the attachment and flag anything operational/legal we need to adjust before Pulse legal takes it?

Thanks,
Karthik

Attachment: Redwood-Pulse-Commission-Proposal-20260521.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, Aanya Rao <aanya@pulseanalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-21T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood <> Pulse: draft commercial playbook (ops questions)

Thanks for the draft — good starting point. A few operational clarifications from our side: 

- Lead registration form: we prefer a simple Google Form + date-stamped confirmation that maps to HubSpot company id. Link: https://forms.gle/redwood-partner-reg (we can gate acceptance).
- Qualification flags: must include customer name, estimated ARR, technical contact, and expected go-live date.
- Onboarding credit: for reseller wins, Redwood can offer a one-time onboarding credit of $3k for engineering integration if the deal is > $50k ARR (we subsidize to accelerate adoption).
- Payment cadence: commission payouts to Pulse on a quarterly schedule with a monthly reporting CSV. Net terms: net 30 from collection confirmation.

Open ops question: for reseller deals where Pulse invoices, can we have a copy of the customer invoice periodically for reconciliation? We’ll need that for audit/compliance on commission payments.

If Pulse legal is okay with the sample clauses, we can produce a final term sheet and a DocuSign envelope for signatures.

Cheers,
Marissa
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwoodinference.com>
To: Pulse Analytics Legal <legal@pulseanalytics.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-05-22T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood <> Pulse: legal comments on commission & reseller terms

Hi Aanya / Pulse Legal team,

Quick read of the draft — overall fine but a few standard redlines we need to close:

1) Audit & recordkeeping: Redwood requires the ability to audit reseller invoices and HubSpot exports once per year with 30 days notice and mutual NDA for the reviewer.
2) Commission holdback: we agree to a short reserve (10%) but propose 60-day holdback for new logos in the first 6 months to account for early churn/chargebacks.
3) Payment timing: Redwood requests net 30 after receipt of complete invoice package; Pulse requested net 30 from collection — we should align on "collection" definition (we define as cleared funds to Redwood).
4) Termination mechanics: commissions for referred customers earned prior to termination should be paid for revenue collected up to 12 months after termination; any deferred commissions on unpaid invoices are void if customer insolvency occurs.

I’ve pasted suggested contract language for the commission reconciliation clause into the Drive doc (link below). If Pulse legal agrees, we can incorporate and ship the term sheet.

Link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C4redwood-pulse-term-sheet

Laura Bennett
